The problems you'll solve will require a curious and analytical mindset, a sharp intuition for product, an ability to speak the language of data, and an understanding that humans should make decisions.
 
At its core, this role is about uncovering dots and—without knowing the shape they form—figuring out how to connect them. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality.
